features.title: Spam, links & blocked words
features.description: Filter bursts of messages, Discord invites, website links, and your own blocked phrases. Espresso checks new messages and text edits in channels it can access.

features.title: Clear boundaries, category by category
features.description: Set racism, misogyny, and anti-trans hate coverage separately. Reveal uncensored examples, catch common combined evasions, and immediately timeout confirmed Unicode-disguised hate. Ordinary Unicode stays allowed.

features.title: Measured action, with a history
features.description: Record warnings and choose when repeated warnings lead to a timeout. Staff can use manual commands, review moderation cases, and remove an individual mistaken warning.

features.title: Let members choose their place
features.description: Post ready-to-edit gender, pronoun, country, interest, notification, and color-label templates. Offer reactions, buttons, or dropdowns with the selection rules your server needs.

features.title: A recipe for each server
features.description: Use guided setup, choose trusted role exemptions and a private staff log, then fine-tune the controls in a dashboard that fits a phone.

features.title: A thoughtful first hello
features.description: Review every new member or flag accounts below your chosen age. Collect rules agreement when required, then grant a Verified access role after the configured checks pass.

features.title: Give concerns a private place
features.description: Members submit reports and appeals and track their own requests. Staff assign reviewers, keep internal notes, and choose a separate member-facing response.

features.title: Different channels, different needs
features.description: Set trusted domains and channel-specific rules. Test a saved or unsaved recipe against example text, roles, warning history, and cooldowns before using it.

features.title: A response when chat gets crowded
features.description: Watch for sudden joins and repeated text from multiple members. Configure alerts or temporary channel protection, exclusions, and restoration of previous settings.

features.title: Know what needs attention
features.description: Check bot permissions, role placement, log channels, member-event access, and verification gating. The dashboard explains what to fix when a requirement is missing.

features.title: Keep everyone in the loop
features.description: Customize welcome cards and schedule announcements in a named timezone. Edit, pause, or repeat posts, and review delivery issues before attempting another send.

features.title: A little personality on the house
features.description: Pick from 12 café drinks and four companions, save your usual, and send illustrated cards. Add Discord polls and your own conversation starters. Each server chooses what to enable.

features.title: Keep the shift in view
features.description: See reports, verification requests, delivery issues, and server health. Review action logs and settings history, then preview an earlier configuration before restoring it.

features.title: A quieter room for support
features.description: Open private ticket channels that the support team can claim and close. Members can request a text transcript when the server allows it; saved transcripts expire after 30 days.

features.title: Give people a reason to gather
features.description: Create native Discord scheduled events. Members opt into DM reminders and any configured event role; Espresso removes its temporary role grants after the gathering ends.

features.title: Let good ideas find their people
features.description: Members submit ideas and vote with persistent buttons. Staff share public status updates as suggestions move from review to a decision or completion.

features.title: A table for a smaller group
features.description: Join a configured lobby to create a personal voice room. Owners adjust its name, size, and connection controls; Espresso cleans up empty rooms.

features.title: Helpful answers, within reach
features.description: Staff write searchable FAQ entries. Members find saved answers with /faq or /tag, so useful server information is easier to find again.

features.title: A little birthday sweetness
features.description: Members opt into a greeting and an optional birthday role. Espresso stores the month and day, and follows the server's chosen timezone for celebrations.

features.title: Keep the lovely moments close
features.description: Share starred messages from approved public channels. Members can opt out, and staff can remove highlights; private-channel messages stay out of the board.

features.title: Familiar faces, a little appreciation
features.description: Members create optional café profiles and thank one another. Staff award community badges; there is no message-count leveling or pressure to keep posting.

link.label: Make it feel like your people
